text:
Auditor Jones: Hi Redwood team — we need chain-of-custody and scoped evidence for the incident on 2026-02-12 where customers reported intermittent 503s and an unexpected billing spike. Please provide auth logs, KMS/keystore access logs, and the repro steps you used. Target window: 2026-02-12 08:10–09:10 UTC. Also include operator access list and checksums.

maria: @Auditor Jones thanks — looping in infra and sec ops. We have a billing ticket (INC-1423) that looks related. I'll start preparing exports and a manifest.

alex: Quick note — we saw JWKS rotation activity during that window. Possible client token mismatches caused auth 401s followed by retries that surfaced as 503s in the gateway. Repro (minimal):

  1. curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <expired-jwt>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  2. Observe: 401 from auth service, client retries, then 503 from gateway due to connection churn

 Logs (internal sample path): s3://redwood-internal/logs/2026-02-12/auth/ (will export slice).

sachin: @maria I'll assemble the keystore audit export (CloudHSM/KMS access logs + keystore operation traces) and include HSM session IDs. ETA ~48h. Need confirmation on sampling: full window or timeboxed slices?

maria: Let's deliver timeboxed slices first: auth logs (08:10–09:10 UTC), gateway metrics (07:50–09:10), billing meter entries (07:45–09:15), keystore/HSM access logs (07:30–09:30). We'll add an appendix with how to replay.

Auditor Jones: That sampling looks good. Please also include the automated runbook used for the JWKS rotation and the list of operators who had keystore/KMS privileges during that window. We will need checksums and a short chain-of-custody statement for each exported object.

eng-security-bot: Deployment event: jwks-rotation v3.1 promoted to prod by deployer:bwilson at 2026-02-12T08:18:42Z. Rollout paused at 2026-02-12T08:22:10Z due to elevated 5xx error rate. Runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/jwks-rotation ; Incident ticket: INC-1423.

maria: Understood. I'll attach the runbook, operators list (RBAC snapshot), and a manifest with presigned S3 links + SHA256 checksums. ETA for full scoped export: 2026-02-18 15:00 UTC.

Auditor Jones: Thanks — please flag if the ETA slips. We may follow up with a playback request (repro script + environment snapshot).

maria: Will do. Adding the playback script stub to the export:

```
# repro script (example)
export START="2026-02-12T08:10:00Z"
export END="2026-02-12T09:10:00Z"
./replay_events --src s3://redwood-internal/logs/ --start $START --end $END --output ./playback
```

maria: Ping @sachin to attach HSM session artifact and notes about key rotation grace period.

sachin: Attached in export: cloudhsm-session-ids.txt, kms-rotation-manifest.json, hsm-trace-logs.tar.gz. All objects will have SHA256 sums in the manifest.

Auditor Jones: Received. Please confirm when presigned links are available and include an index file with checksums and the chain-of-custody statement. Appreciate the quick coordination.
